paper.title_en: Perturbations and quasinormal modes of black holes in general relativity coupled to nonlinear electrodynamics
paper.abstract_en: We investigate the quasinormal spectra and time-domain evolution of scalar, electromagnetic, and gravitational perturbations of the Einstein-Bronnikov black hole in Einstein gravity coupled to nonlinear electrodynamics. The effective potentials associated with all perturbation sectors are shown to form positive potential barriers that vanish at the event horizon and spatial infinity. Their height increases with the magnetic charge, while the scalar perturbation possesses the largest potential barrier. Unlike the Reissner-Nordström black hole, axial and polar electromagnetic perturbations are characterized by distinct effective potentials, demonstrating the breaking of isospectrality due to nonlinear electrodynamics. Quasinormal frequencies are computed using the sixth-order WKB approximation and the asymptotic iteration method, yielding excellent agreement for both fundamental and higher overtone modes. The oscillation frequencies increase monotonically with the magnetic charge, whereas the damping rates exhibit only moderate variations, confirming the linear stability of the Einstein-Bronnikov black hole under all perturbations considered. Time-domain profiles display exponentially damped ringdown signals consistent with the frequency-domain analysis. These results demonstrate that nonlinear electrodynamics leaves measurable imprints on black hole perturbations and may provide observational signatures for testing regular black hole geometries through future gravitational wave observations.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文研究爱因斯坦引力与非线电动力学耦合下Einstein-Bronnikov黑洞的标量、电磁与引力扰动，涉及准正规模、等谱性破缺与线性稳定性，属于广义相对论基础与黑洞物理的核心理论问题。采用六阶WKB近似与渐近迭代法两种独立方法并给出一致结果，方法严谨性较强；明确给出等谱性破缺与非线电动力学可观测印记等新颖结论，摘要结构清晰、量化结果具体。暂无引用，符合新论文零引用为中性之规则。
decision.title_zh: 广义相对论耦合非线性电动力学中黑洞的扰动与准正规模
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了爱因斯坦引力耦合非线性电动力学中Einstein-Bronnikov黑洞的标量、电磁与引力扰动的准正规模谱及时间域演化。所有扰动扇区对应的有效势均被证明构成在事件视界与空间无穷远处消失的正势垒。其高度随磁荷增大而增大，而标量扰动具有最大的势垒。与Reissner-Nordström黑洞不同，轴向与极向电磁扰动具有不同的有效势，表明非线性电动力学导致等谱性破缺。准正规模频率使用六阶WKB近似与渐近迭代法计算，两者对于基频模与高阶泛音模均给出极好的一致性。振荡频率随磁荷单调增大，而阻尼率仅表现出适度的变化，证实了Einstein-Bronnikov黑洞在所考虑的所有扰动下的线性稳定性。时间域剖面显示出与频域分析一致的指数衰减的铃宕信号。这些结果表明，非线性电动力学在黑洞扰动上留下可测量的印记，并可能为通过未来引力波观测检验正则黑洞几何提供观测信号。
